comment: ANCHOR: SELF_HEAL_RUNBOOK_DOCS_20261108 — the self-heal workbook (docs/runbooks/self_heal/, LQ-1259) is
generated, and this gate proves it cannot drift: regenerating from config/self_heal_runbook_catalog.json +
docs/runbooks/self_heal/COVERAGE.json + the corpus index reproduces every committed page byte for byte,
every catalog entry has exactly one page, no page is orphaned, every page carries its ten sections and links
the index, and the index links every entry. The snapshot must be consistent with itself (hits add up per
signature and per entry) and with the catalog (it names this catalog version, every signature resolves to an
existing entry with a whitelisted action, and no catch-all signature lacks a written reason). A generated page
may carry no IPv4 address, e-mail, token or long hex: the repository is public. It does NOT prove the pages
reflect live state — that is the replay's own --check-gate — nor that any runbook action would work.
